description: This file defines the 'Enforcer' interface, which provides methods for permission enforcement and querying within a resource authorization context. It includes methods for checking permissions, building JSON views based on permissions, and handling partial permissions, all related to resource access control.

classes.name: Enforcer
classes.description: Interface for permission enforcement algorithms on resources within a given authorization context.

methods.name: hasUnrestrictedPermissions
methods.description: Checks if the authorization context has explicit or implicit 'GRANT' permissions on a resource, considering 'REVOKE's down the hierarchy.

methods.name: getSubjectIdsWithPermission
methods.description: Returns subject IDs with all permissions granted or revoked on a resource; deprecated in favor of a method accepting Permissions object.

methods.name: getSubjectsWithPermission
methods.description: Returns subjects with all permissions granted or revoked on a resource.

methods.name: getSubjectIdsWithPartialPermission
methods.description: Returns subject IDs with permissions granted on a resource or its sub-resources; deprecated in favor of a method accepting Permissions object.

methods.name: getSubjectsWithPartialPermission
methods.description: Returns subjects with partial permissions on a resource or its sub-resources.

methods.name: hasPartialPermissions
methods.description: Checks if the authorization context has 'GRANT' permissions somewhere down the resource hierarchy.

methods.name: buildJsonView
methods.description: Builds a JSON view of fields for which the authorization context has the required permissions, optionally with allowlist filtering.
